title: GROUND & CARRY
why: Total pattern break. No station blocks, no EMOM clock, no treadmill run. Your shoulders and arms are sore from work but your legs are fresh, so today's engine is loaded carries and ground movement, not pressing and not running. You move weight through space for distance and by feel: farmer and suitcase carries, walking lunges, a little crawling. All of it is grip, legs, and midline, with the sore delts and arms kept out of the line of fire (nothing overhead, nothing pressed). The carries ARE the cardio today, so your heart rate climbs without pounding your legs, and the treadmill only shows up as an easy incline walk to flush at the very end. Mobility opens it with extra shoulder love, core closes it, about 60 minutes.

blocks.title: MOBILITY WARM-UP
blocks.meta: ~10 min · standing rule · biased to the sore shoulders + a ground-day prep
blocks.text: No treadmill jog today. Start on the floor. Original Strength resets: diaphragmatic breathing x5 · head nods + slow rotations 5 each · quadruped rock-backs x10 (segment the spine) · segmental rolling 3/side · slow baby-crawl 30s (patterns the crawl coming later). Then spine + hips: cat-cow x8 · thoracic open-book 5/side · 90/90 hip switches 6/side · deep-squat pry x5. Then give the sore shoulders real attention: scapular CARs (slow shoulder circles) 5/side · wall slides x8 · thread-the-needle 5/side · cross-body + doorway pec opener 20s each. Move slow, breathe into the sore spots, wake the shoulders up without loading them.

blocks.title: THE CARRY MEDLEY
blocks.meta: ~24 min · 2x40 lb + 50 lb DB · the engine today
blocks.workRest: flow through all four carries = 1 round · rest 60-90s · target 4-6 rounds · stop a round before grip or posture breaks

items.name: A · Farmer Carry
items.detail: 2x40 (80 lb) · ~40 yd · stand tall, crush the handles

items.name: B · Suitcase Carry — Right
items.detail: 50 lb DB · ~20 yd · do NOT lean, stay stacked

items.name: C · Suitcase Carry — Left
items.detail: 50 lb DB · ~20 yd · match the right side

items.name: D · Goblet-Hold March
items.detail: 50 lb DB at the chest · ~30 yd · ribs down, brace, march tall

blocks.text: This is the whole cardio session, done as loaded locomotion instead of a run. One round = farmer carry, then a suitcase carry each side, then a goblet march, flowing one into the next. Rest 60-90s and go again. Chase 4 to 6 rounds by feel and total distance covered, not a clock. Every carry loads grip, traps, legs, and core and keeps your sore shoulders passive. If your grip is the limiter (it will be), set the bells down, shake it out 10s, and finish the yardage. If the 50 goblet bugs your arms, swap it for a double-KB front-load (2x40 held at the chest) or just do another farmer lap. Breathe steady the whole way, you should be working but able to talk in short bursts.

blocks.title: GROUND & LUNGE
blocks.meta: ~10 min · bodyweight + 50 lb DB · fresh-leg locomotion + the crawl wildcard

items.name: Walking Reverse Lunges
items.detail: 20 total (10/side) · bodyweight, drive through the heel

items.name: Leopard Crawl
items.detail: ~12 yd out + back · low, knees hover, slow and quiet (WILDCARD)

items.name: Goblet Squat
items.detail: 50 lb DB · 10 · full depth, elbows inside the knees

blocks.text: Legs are fresh, so spend them here on the ground. Reverse lunges are easy on the knees and the back, drive tall out of each one. The leopard crawl is today's wildcard: hands and toes, knees hovering an inch off the floor, move slow and controlled for coordination and midline, not speed. It touches the shoulders lightly, so if the sore delts complain, skip it and do one more lunge lap instead, no ego. Finish each round with goblet squats, deep and controlled. 3 rounds, 4 if you feel good.

blocks.title: CORE FINISHER
blocks.meta: ~8 min · anti-rotation / anti-extension · standing rule · no pressing

items.name: Suitcase Hold March
items.detail: 50 lb DB one side · 30s/side · stay stacked, don't lean

items.name: Dead Bug
items.detail: 8/side · low back pinned flat to the floor

items.name: Hollow Hold
items.detail: 30s · ribs down, low back glued down

blocks.text: Your standing end-of-session midline block, kept completely off the sore shoulders. Suitcase hold is a static anti-lateral carry (grip and core, arm just hangs). Dead bug and hollow are anti-extension, bird-dog is anti-rotation. Brace hard, move slow, quality over reps. Carries already hit your core hard today, so 3 clean rounds is plenty.

blocks.title: COOLDOWN
blocks.text: Now the only treadmill of the day: easy incline walk 3-4 min @ 3 mph, 8-10% incline. Low-impact, flushes the legs, keeps the aerobic base ticking without any pounding. Then open up the sore shoulders and thoracic: child's pose 45s · thread-the-needle 5/side · doorway pec stretch 30s/side · cross-body shoulder stretch 30s/side · slow neck rolls · 5 deep breaths. Spend the extra time on whatever shoulder position felt tightest.

timer.emomUnit: no clock today — carries by distance & feel
